notes:
## What's new
- Choose matching movie versions before playback and alternative live channels from fullscreen controls. Choices are remembered locally per profile, including M3U quality variants that share an EPG ID.
- Adjust supported VOD subtitle timing by up to 5 seconds in 100 ms steps. Offsets are saved per title/profile; applying an adjustment may briefly buffer playback.
- Search Settings in English or Portuguese (Portugal), then jump to the matching control or group.

## Fixes
- Correct stale resolution badges when switching channels between the mini player and fullscreen.
- Apply preferred movie audio/subtitle languages earlier, recognise more language labels, and keep subtitle choices from suppressing audio selection.
- Wait for track discovery before automatically searching for external subtitles.

## Validation
- Kotlin compilation, 513 unit tests, lint, and debug APK assembly passed before release preparation. The release script also runs unit tests and builds/signature-verifies the release APK.
- Physical tablet playback, PiP, and D-pad interaction checks for these changes remain outstanding.

## Novidades
- Escolha versões de filmes e canais em direto, com a seleção guardada localmente por perfil.
- Ajuste a sincronização das legendas VOD suportadas em passos de 100 ms, até 5 segundos para cada lado, com o ajuste guardado por título/perfil.
- Pesquise nas Definições e aceda ao controlo ou grupo correspondente.
- Corrigidos os indicadores de resolução e a seleção automática dos idiomas de áudio e legendas.

FortressTV includes no content or source credentials. Use sources you are authorised to access.
